// About Me

Engineering Infrastructure
That Runs Itself

I am a B.Tech Computer Science graduate from Andhra Pradesh with strong hands-on expertise in AWS cloud engineering and DevOps. I don't just know the theory — I have built and deployed real systems on live AWS infrastructure.

My focus is on automation and reliability. I build pipelines where infrastructure is created with code, containers run securely, and every deployment is traceable and reversible. No manual clicking — everything reproducible.

I am equally comfortable with AWS Cloud architecture (VPC, EC2, IAM, ECS, ALB, RDS) and DevOps tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD) — giving me a complete picture of how systems are built and operated in production.

Targeting roles in AWS Cloud Engineering, DevOps Engineering, Cloud Support, and Infrastructure Engineering — open to full-time, internship, and remote opportunities.
